title: MTL Archives Content Behavior Aggregate Envelope v1
description: Envelope-only schema for the metadata carried by each social/product aggregate row emitted by the local cross-platform report. A full emitted row also contains a row-type-specific metric payload and therefore is intentionally not valid against this schema (additionalProperties is false). Project the eight fields named by AGGREGATE_ENVELOPE_FIELDS before validation. This envelope is not post-level attribution or factual archive truth.
